1.summary: Discounts now round half-cents up, not down. The edit is one line in a shared pricing function, so totals change in Checkout and in Order Import.

sections.title: What changes
sections.text: `applyDiscount()` adds 50 before it divides by 100. A 105-cent order at 10% now gets an 11-cent discount (total 94), not a 10-cent one (total 95).

sections.title: Why
sections.text: REQ-17: discounts round to the nearest cent, half-cents up.

sections.title: What it reaches
sections.text: `checkoutTotal()` in Checkout and `importOrder()` in Order Import. Both call `applyDiscount()`. Neither is in the diff.

sections.title: What is tested
sections.text: Checkout: two REQ-17 tests pass on this commit. Order Import: no test runs a discounted order through it.

sections.title: What stays the same
sections.text: A zero discount still totals 105 cents.
